  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-003 is clearly stated and specifies a functional capability of the SFMC software to allow pilot selection of a navigation destination. It is supported by the SRS context, particularly section 3.1 Navigation, which includes related requirements such as route calculation (SFMC-REQ-004) and autopilot control (SFMC-REQ-005). The requirement is consistent with the system overview and pilot interface descriptions in sections 1.2 and 2.1, which describe pilot controls and navigation functions. The requirement is verifiable and unambiguous, with no undefined terms or vague criteria. There is no explicit software allocation detail beyond the SFMC software responsibility, which is appropriate given the SRS scope. No direct NPR passages justify linking to SWE-050, SWE-051, SWE-184, SWE-053, SWE-054, or SWE-055 for this specific requirement. The Handbook guidance (NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 §3.2.1) supports organizing functional requirements into groups such as navigation, which this requirement is part of. Overall, the requirement is well-formed and acceptable."
